mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id, e.stock_code, pv.product_name, e.annual_return_10y AS annual_return_10y_percent FROM kb_product_data_version dv JOIN kb_product_version pv ON pv.kb_product_data_version_id = dv.kb_product_data_version_id JOIN kb_product p ON p.product_id = pv.product_id JOIN etf e ON e.kb_product_version_id = pv.kb_product_version_id WHERE dv.kb_product_data_version_id = ( SELECT completed.kb_product_data_version_id FROM kb_product_data_version completed WHERE completed.status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY completed.data_date DESC, completed.kb_product_data_version_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND pv.sales_status = 'ON_SALE' ORDER BY p.product_id
SELECT pv.product_id FROM etf e JOIN kb_product_version pv ON pv.kb_product_version_id = e.kb_product_version_id WHERE e.stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY pv.kb_product_version_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO kb_product (product_code, product_type) VALUES (#{productCode}, 'ETF')

INSERT INTO etf_history_price (product_id, base_date, close_price, data_source) VALUES
(#{price.productId}, #{price.baseDate}, #{price.closePrice}, #{price.dataSource})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE close_price = VALUES(close_price), data_source = VALUES(data_source)
mapper.select: SELECT kb_product_data_version_id FROM kb_product_data_version WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY data_date DESC, kb_product_data_version_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_product_data_version WHERE status = 'LOADING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_product_data_version (version_code, data_date, status) VALUES (#{versionCode}, #{dataDate}, 'LOADING')

INSERT INTO kb_product_version (kb_product_data_version_id, product_id, product_name, description, product_url, sales_status) SELECT #{targetDataVersionId}, product_id, product_name, description, product_url, sales_status FROM kb_product_version WHERE kb_product_data_version_id = #{sourceDataVersionId}

INSERT INTO deposit (kb_product_version_id, min_amount, max_amount, min_month, max_month) SELECT target.kb_product_version_id, detail.min_amount, detail.max_amount, detail.min_month, detail.max_month FROM kb_product_version source JOIN deposit detail ON detail.kb_product_version_id = source.kb_product_version_id JOIN kb_product_version target ON target.kb_product_data_version_id = #{targetDataVersionId} AND target.product_id = source.product_id WHERE source.kb_product_data_version_id = #{sourceDataVersionId}

INSERT INTO savings (kb_product_version_id, savings_category, min_month, max_month, monthly_min_amount, monthly_max_amount) SELECT target.kb_product_version_id, detail.savings_category, detail.min_month, detail.max_month, detail.monthly_min_amount, detail.monthly_max_amount FROM kb_product_version source JOIN savings detail ON detail.kb_product_version_id = source.kb_product_version_id JOIN kb_product_version target ON target.kb_product_data_version_id = #{targetDataVersionId} AND target.product_id = source.product_id WHERE source.kb_product_data_version_id = #{sourceDataVersionId}

INSERT INTO etf (kb_product_version_id, stock_code, etf_category, tracking_index, annual_return_10y, bond_ratio, risk_level) SELECT target.kb_product_version_id, detail.stock_code, detail.etf_category, detail.tracking_index, detail.annual_return_10y, detail.bond_ratio, detail.risk_level FROM kb_product_version source JOIN etf detail ON detail.kb_product_version_id = source.kb_product_version_id JOIN kb_product_version target ON target.kb_product_data_version_id = #{targetDataVersionId} AND target.product_id = source.product_id WHERE source.kb_product_data_version_id = #{sourceDataVersionId}

INSERT INTO base_interest_rate (kb_product_version_id, min_month, max_month, base_rate_percent, max_rate_percent, base_date) SELECT target.kb_product_version_id, rate.min_month, rate.max_month, rate.base_rate_percent, rate.max_rate_percent, rate.base_date FROM kb_product_version source JOIN base_interest_rate rate ON rate.kb_product_version_id = source.kb_product_version_id JOIN kb_product_version target ON target.kb_product_data_version_id = #{targetDataVersionId} AND target.product_id = source.product_id WHERE source.kb_product_data_version_id = #{sourceDataVersionId}

INSERT INTO preferential_interest_rate (kb_product_version_id, additional_rate_percent, condition_code, preferential_condition, base_date) SELECT target.kb_product_version_id, rate.additional_rate_percent, rate.condition_code, rate.preferential_condition, rate.base_date FROM kb_product_version source JOIN preferential_interest_rate rate ON rate.kb_product_version_id = source.kb_product_version_id JOIN kb_product_version target ON target.kb_product_data_version_id = #{targetDataVersionId} AND target.product_id = source.product_id WHERE source.kb_product_data_version_id = #{sourceDataVersionId}

INSERT INTO etf_holding (kb_product_version_id, holding_rank, holding_name, holding_code, asset_type, country_code, weight_percent, base_date) SELECT target.kb_product_version_id, holding.holding_rank, holding.holding_name, holding.holding_code, holding.asset_type, holding.country_code, holding.weight_percent, holding.base_date FROM kb_product_version source JOIN etf_holding holding ON holding.kb_product_version_id = source.kb_product_version_id JOIN kb_product_version target ON target.kb_product_data_version_id = #{targetDataVersionId} AND target.product_id = source.product_id WHERE source.kb_product_data_version_id = #{sourceDataVersionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_product_data_version SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW() WHERE kb_product_data_version_id = #{targetDataVersionId} AND status = 'LOADING'
